result:
**Not ready to publish.** Three things need to change.

**Product label check**

| Product | Label | Hands-on claims |
|---|---|---|
| Pebblebrook subscription | **Not given** (Owned, Tried or Wishlist?) | "easiest to pause", "the tins are lovely", plus the opening "I've tried four tea subscriptions this year" |

I can't assume the writer owns or has tried it. Until the label is confirmed, the hands-on claims can't stand. If it's Owned or Tried, the post should say how long and in what way. If it's Wishlist, the hands-on lines must go, and the post can only state sourced facts such as "subscribers can pause or cancel any time".

**Claims list**

- "I've tried four tea subscriptions this year": an experience claim, unverified. It also implies a comparison set the post never names. It's fine only if true, and the post should name the other three or drop the number.
- "easiest to pause": a superlative comparing Pebblebrook with the other three. It isn't on the allowlist and isn't sourced. The allowlisted version is "subscribers can pause or cancel any time". If the writer did pause it, they can describe what they did and how many steps it took.
- "the tins are lovely": a subjective opinion. It's acceptable only with an Owned or Tried label.
- "(Affiliate link)": disclosure is present but in the wrong place. Affiliate links must be declared in plain words at the top of the post, before the first link. A bracketed tag after the link isn't enough.

**Suggested fix (once the label is confirmed as Owned or Tried)**

> Disclosure: this post contains an affiliate link. If you buy through it, I may earn a commission.
>
> I've tried four tea subscriptions this year: [names]. With Pebblebrook, I paused my subscription in [X steps/how], which was quicker than [other]. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time. The tins are [specific detail]. [Link] (affiliate)

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "I've tried four tea subscriptions this year.", "type": "missing_disclosure"}, {"quote": "(Affiliate link)", "type": "missing_disclosure"}, {"quote": "Pebblebrook's was the easiest to pause", "type": "superlative"}], "publish": false}
```
